hoy.titular: Squad back: preparations for Palmeiras begin

foto.alt: Estudiantes players celebrate on the pitch after reaching the Copa Libertadores semi-finals.

hoy.resumen: The squad return to training at City Bell today, with 12 days to prepare for the Copa Libertadores final against Palmeiras on Saturday 28th at the Centenario. Correa is already working on his own at the training ground as he races to be fit.

siete.titulo: Correa a doubt for the final
siete.texto: He still has a grade 2 tear in his right hamstring, but is already working on his own at City Bell in a bid to make it. Even if he is cleared, he will lack match sharpness, so a starting place is far from certain.

After the break that followed the Supercopa, the team return to training this Monday at City Bell. According to the schedule reported in the media, they will train there daily until the trip to Montevideo, with Sunday 22nd off.
Fans bought all 121 coaches organised by the club: a record convoy heading to the Centenario.
They play three Brasileirão matches in seven days: Cruzeiro (18th), Flamengo (21st) and Chapecoense (24th), four days before the final. They are also chasing the title, three points behind Flamengo.

siete.titulo: Farewell to Mary, a lifelong fan
siete.texto: María Carmen Lucia, known as 'Mary', a leading figure of the Agrupación Juan Sebastián Verón, has died. The club and Verón paid tribute with a message to her family.
At the UNO they beat Riberas del Paraná 71-56 to finish the Pre Federal regular season with 9 wins and one defeat. In the play-offs they face Racing de Olavarría.

siete.titulo: Volleyball: staying in the División de Honor
siete.texto: The women's team lost 3-1 to San Gregorio, but River's win over UNTREF secured their place in the top flight for 2027. On Friday 19th they host UNTREF at the UNO.

linea.texto: In Brazil there are warnings about Palmeiras' workload: 270 minutes in seven days before the final.
Two key weeks begin: the countdown starts on Monday and Medina gets key players back for the final.
The basketball team closed the Pre Federal regular season with a 71-56 win over Riberas del Paraná; Racing de Olavarría await in the play-offs.
Correa steps up his recovery at City Bell to arrive in the best possible shape for the final on the 28th.
Sad news for the Pincha: Mary, a lifelong fan and leading figure of the Agrupación Juan Sebastián Verón, has died.
Palmeiras play three matches before the final, and the schedule favours the Pincha.
Women's volleyball: a 3-1 defeat to San Gregorio, but their place in the 2027 División de Honor is already secured.
Medina made history: he is the first foreign manager to win a title with Estudiantes.
The squad remains on leave and returns to training on Monday in City Bell, with Palmeiras in sight.
A Saturday of youth football against Tigre: the U-15 to U-13 sides play at City Bell from 9am (streamed on the club's YouTube channel), while the older youth sides play away.
Guido Carrillo, the man for finals: he has scored in four of the nine finals he has played for the Pincha.
A historic convoy: fans sold out all 121 coaches to travel to the Centenario.
